author: Ogrey
body:
Hello Avicadians! It is me Evocal bringing a new map alongside my friend Meowfrees for Nebula!

This is a future / space themed TDM map where players get 1 iron ingot each time they kill an enemy player.
This map also features a special bow, that shoots wither skulls upon its use!
You start off with 3 arrows, however, each time you kill someone, you get 1 extra arrow! (And you can buy even more from the shop, of course)

Well guys, both of the maps are designed in a way so they both carry good aesthetics and good gameplay, so I hope you guys enjoy them!

Download Link: https://www.mediafire.com/?cl7ik68982qc4ry
Map Name: Eclipse
Gamemode: Nebula
Map Creators: Evocal & Meowfrees
